name: Sumo Romanian Deadlift
description: A Romanian deadlift performed with a wide sumo stance and toes pointed out. This stance shifts loading emphasis to the adductors, inner hamstrings, and glutes compared to a conventional RDL, and allows a more upright torso while still training the hip hinge pattern under load.

execution.starting_position: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, toes pointing outward at 30 to 45 degrees. Grip a barbell with a double-overhand grip, hands inside the knees.
execution.setup_instructions: Set a barbell on a rack or start from the floor in a sumo stance. Feet wide, toes flared, bar over mid-foot.
steps: Step 1: Brace the core and hinge at the hips, keeping the knees in line with the toes.
Step 2: Lower the bar along the inner thighs and legs, feeling the inner hamstrings and adductors stretch.
Step 3: Once a strong stretch is felt through the posterior chain, drive the hips forward.
Step 4: Extend the hips fully and squeeze the glutes at the top.
execution.breathing_instructions: Inhale and brace before hinging. Exhale on the drive to standing.
common_mistakes: Allowing the knees to cave inward during the movement
Rounding the lower back at the bottom
safety_considerations: Ensure the knees track in line with the toes throughout the movement
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Lower until a strong hamstring and inner thigh stretch is felt. Full hip extension at the top.
coaching_cues: Push the knees out in line with the toes
Feel the stretch in the inner hamstrings
